findings.evidence: `Homology/Basic.lean:79` defines boundaries-in-cycles via `submoduleOf`, i.e. B∩Z, while `BasicCycles.lean:80` only proves B≤Z conditional on square-zero; repository search finds no unconditional square-zero theorem, and this file explicitly says at lines 20–21 that none is needed.
findings.fix: First prove `fullyBlockedDifferential.comp fullyBlockedDifferential = 0` and define genuine homology using `fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles`; otherwise rename these as subquotient equivalences and do not present them as the roadmap's homology isomorphisms.
findings.issue: `fullyBlockedHomologyTransposeEquiv`, `fullyBlockedHomologyRotateEquiv` (169), and `fullyBlockedHomologySwapMarkingsEquiv` (230) claim homology-level symmetries without proving ∂²=0; their target is actually Z/(B∩Z), which can differ from Z/B.

summary: The three equivalences are only equivalences of the surrogate subquotient Z/(B∩Z), not homology equivalences, because square-zero has not been established.
